name: SVC_TIME_OF_DAY
description: Stores a row for every minute of the day to facilitate aggregation report by various time intervals.

columns.name: TIME_OF_DAY_ID
columns.description: Generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AM_PM_CD
columns.description: Stores whether the time of the day is AM or PM.

columns.name: HH12MI
columns.description: Stores the 12 hour format of the time of the day.

columns.name: HH24MI
columns.description: Stores the 24 hour format of the time of the day.

columns.name: HOUR_12
columns.description: Stores the hour in the 12 hour format of the time of the day.

columns.name: HOUR_24
columns.description: Stores the hour in the 24 hour format of the time of the day.

columns.name: MINUTE
columns.description: Stores the minute of the time of the day.

columns.name: QUARTER_HOUR
columns.description: Stores the quarter hour num for the time of the day.

columns.name: QUARTER_HOUR_OF_DAY
columns.description: Stores the quarter hour of the day for the time of the day.

columns.name: TIME_SESSION_CD
columns.description: Stores the time session of the time of the day.
